task_name: Implement territory management and geographic BI

concerns_addressed: Territory CRUD/assignment durable via Eloquent writes; renamed territory and outlet assignment persist and survive pipeline publication.
GeographicAnalyticsService produces the named geographic snapshot section with 30-day eligible aggregates and Unassigned fallback.
GeographicAnalyticsController reads only the active immutable snapshot via ActiveDataSnapshotReader and returns snapshot_version plus window metadata.
Map points filtered to valid coordinates while table retains Unassigned records.
All new territory/geographic routes are admin-only and preserve the existing 401/403 authorization contract.

strengths: BI consumer reads active snapshot only; no live recompute.
Stage producer money-safe with Unassigned fallback.
Valid-coordinate filtering applied at consumer boundary.

issues.description: Unused $timezone variable assigned from window in produce().
isValidCoordinate casts to float before range check; non-numeric strings pass. Add is_numeric guard for strict compliance.
